title: Theatre, Minor (College of Arts and Architecture)
notes: 18cr total, exact bulletin match. Core Requirement: 'select ONE of THEA 100/101N/105' -- picked THEA 100 (Art of the Theatre, no prereq), which also happens to be the option every downstream 400-level THEA course's own OR-group prereq lists (e.g. THEA 401's 'DANCE 100 or THEA 100/105/106/112'). Supporting Courses: 'select 15cr from THEA, DANCE, or approved supporting courses, min 6cr at 400-level' -- filled with THEA 102 + THEA 103 + THEA 130 (all no-prereq, 9cr) plus THEA 401 + THEA 419 (both satisfied entirely by the prescribed THEA 100, 6cr at 400-level). Avoided THEA 285/484 (the Music Technology minor's own prescribed courses) since their real prereq needs INART 258A, not otherwise part of this minor.
